title: Dependency Management
definition: The practice of defining and managing the dependencies of a software project.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a project is a puzzle, and dependencies are the pieces it needs to fit together. Dependency management helps make sure you use the right pieces and the right versions.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Dependency management involves specifying which packages a project needs and their versions. It ensures consistency and reproducibility, making it easier to install and run the project on any environment.
difficulty_levels.expert: Dependency management goes beyond simply installing packages. It includes dealing with version conflicts, managing transitive dependencies, and ensuring security. It also has philosophical implications, such as the challenge of determining what exactly a software project depends on, and the role of determinism and reproducibility in science and software development.

extra_fields.insight: The need for version pinning in requirements.txt to ensure stability, while allowing flexibility in development environments with version ranges.
